connector.name: MCP Microsoft Todo
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for Microsoft To Do via Microsoft Graph. MSAL device code flow, no client secret needed.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-microsoft-todo. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
